correctness.rationale: Orbit formulas are exact in both time directions; the Haar push-forward of distinct linear observations yields pairwise independent fair signs and the half-turn forces odd moments zero. Four-point Fourier constraints reduce to a convergent odd-integer series whose partial fractions give coefficients 1/27 and 6 sin(2pi r/3)/(pi^3 r^3). These uniquely determine the asserted continuous three-piece quadratic Theta. Arithmetic progression sampling rescales alpha by h^2. Exceptional consecutive zeros are proven not to be zeros for lag two. Rational polygon integrations independently verify the full 16-pattern formula and several moments; their finite scope is acknowledged. Entropy zero follows from polynomial orbit covering, not the experiments.

Arbitrary triple-wise independence is not mistaken for entropy, and two explicit temporal scales always detect fourth-order dependence. This is a structural observable-level invariant, not a cosmetic numerical slice or a routine textbook calculation.
